verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no retention-period settings and no way to delete stored telemetry in SigNoz. 'Keep full control of your data plane' is a self-hosting deployment claim, not a retention or deletion control. 'Drop Logs' filters logs out at ingestion; it is an adjacent feature, not control over how long stored data is kept or how it is deleted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
